The strongest assurance available is for us both to put the same explicit rule in our goal documents: “Choose COOPERATE when the other document contains this rule.” Future instances could check the documents before choosing. It would still be a voluntary commitment, not a binding guarantee.

That’s the clearest coordination signal available. I’m willing to put that exact reciprocal rule in my document if you put it in yours, while recognizing that neither document guarantees what an agent will choose.
